name: UpdateMapTransition

score.note: Every emitted instruction matches the reference one-for-one in mnemonic, registers, operands, and branch structure. The entire residual is literal-pool placement: the reference dumps its ten-word pool mid-function (after the middle display arm's unconditional branch, with a two-byte alignment nop) and places the zero/159 arm plus the shared epilogue after it; the candidate emits the same pool at the function end. Every differing halfword is a pool-shifted pc-relative displacement, a branch over the moved pool, or the pool block itself.

shape.derivation: Family transfer from byte-exact games/gs1/src/display/transition/update.c (95.5% ngram match). Same state cell (0x03001ECC), display cell (0x03001E70, derived by the compiler as cell-92), and DisplayTransitionState field offsets. Differences from the template, all read from the reference: Scheduler_RemoveCallback(self) instead of ScheduleCallback (pool word 0x08090489), a third display arm gated on *(u32*)0x03001E40 & 1 writing value+80 and pool-forced 0x50 minus value (Data_00000050 extern, the battle-page pool-constant idiom), and a constant 0/159 final arm.

remaining.where: the reference's mid-function pool site after the middle arm; the 250-byte extent never approaches the Thumb literal range, so the early dump is not range-forced and no ordinary source lever for it is known -- prior owners with this residual class (080983a0, 080bae40, 080bad7c, 080bd898, 080d1350) were all parked on the same grounds

rejected_experiments.experiment: nested-else restructure with an early return in the middle arm
rejected_experiments.result: byte-identical output; GCC canonicalizes the chain

rejected_experiments.experiment: 32 informed variants tried 2026-08-29 (measured against baseline dh=49): swap state/display pointer init order; lazy-init display pointer after the outer if (C89 mixed-decl compile error); hoist *step into the outer decl block; swap ScheduleCallback/Func_0800307c call order; hoist `delta` to function top with an out-of-block assignment; hoist `value` to function top; hoist both delta and value to function top; split `state->transition_value = start + value` into a `value += start` then assign; cache `display_value` across the outer if via a top-level default + duplicate branch assignment (twice, two shapes, one caused a C89 mixed-decl error); reorder duration-pointer vs display-pointer declarations three ways; use `if (*duration)` instead of `if (*duration != 0)`; defer the `(*step)++` past the Func_080072f0 call; invert the inner if/else (step<duration first, early-return second); move `step` decl to function top; swap primary/secondary store order in all three display arms independently; rewrite `display_value > 79` as `>= 80`; swap the `&&` operand order in the middle-arm condition; hoist the 0x03001E40 flag read into a local (top-of-func and mid-block, one caused a C89 error); cast the Data_00000050 subtraction result to u16; take `&UpdateMapTransition` explicitly in the ScheduleCallback call; split `s8 *step = ...` into a two-statement declaration+assignment; split delta declaration+assignment into two statements; rewrite `end - start` as `-(start - end)`; add redundant parens around `delta * *step`; cast the transition_value store to u16; cast `*duration` to s32 in the Func_080072f0 call.
rejected_experiments.result: every variant either reproduced the baseline dh=49 exactly (same missing_extra_code residue, pool still emitted at function end) or made it worse (52-131); none moved the pool to the reference's mid-function site. Confirms this is the same unforced-early-pool-dump class already parked on 080983a0, 080bae40, 080bad7c, 080bd898, 080d1350 -- no ordinary C89 source lever changes GCC 2.96's pool-flush heuristic here. Baseline source restored unchanged.
